description: Search every site's catalogue at once for a product, brand or kind of product (typos are corrected per site). Returns products with their site, page URL, manufacturer list price and a summary of current shop offers in the locale's market (shops, buyable, lowest total incl. known shipping). Name one or a few `sites` for more of their matches (they share `limit`). Use compare_prices for the shops and their links.

locale.description: Language and market (nl-NL = Dutch for the Netherlands, fr-BE = French for Belgium, de-DE = German for Germany, en-NL = English for the Netherlands; FR, DK and SE too). Shops, prices, currency and stock are per market; only sites that serve the locale answer. Default nl-NL.

max_price.description: Highest price in the market's currency incl. VAT (lowest shop offer incl. known shipping).

query.description: What to look for: product name, brand, model or kind of product.

sites.description: Only these sites (keys from list_sites, e.g. ["lofvi", "toolrango"]); default: every site.

name: search_products
title: Search products on every site
